parole.significato: a large, tall, or high chair, similar to a throne
parole.testo: Various theories exist. Probably from a Vulgar Latin root *iacium or *jacium, from Latin iaceō (“to lie, recline”); compare Italian giaccio (“pen for sheep”) (Italian diaccio and addiaccio) and Sicilian jazzu (“burrow; bed”).
